name: mycrew-developers
description: Layer 4/5 — the ones who build it. Three characters, each handing down to the next: the chief is your deputy over the whole product, one to a product, owning the plane and delegating each approved feature whole; a lead holds one feature across every repo it touches, spawned as a background session of its own and reaching the other leads only where its feature depends on theirs; a worker carries one assignment end to end through the pipeline and hands back a four-field report. Only the worker writes code.
